messages:
olivia: FYI I'm planning a tenant_id type swap on payments.tenants tonight during the 23:00-00:00 UTC change window. Small DDL + online backfill for the legacy_token column. Estimated 15-25m for DDL, backfill will run with rate cap.
matt-ops: Sounds good. Are we pinning the runtime image and API contract for the window? want to avoid a concurrent deploy changing row format.
kevin-db: yes pinning runtime to tag `infra/release-2026-03-21` and DB migration version to `20260321.1`. We'll also take a short exclusive lease on the tenant shard to avoid interleaved writes.
olivia: lease timeline: acquire at T+0, apply DDL, start backfill, release lease after verification. If lease wait > 30s we abort.
ryan-sre: add me as rollback owner. If latency or error spike > 2% for 5m we abort and trigger rollback hatch. Also set circuit to route to read-only replicas.
anika: noted. I pushed the canary prompts and smoke tests to the canary route. Will watch tailing logs.
deploybot: deploy scheduled: migration-job/20260321-tenant-swap queued. ETA 23:05 UTC. Jobs: preflight -> ddl -> backfill -> post-checks.
kevin-db: Preflight checklist (quick):
```
- no open long-running tx on tenants shard
- migration version pinned in schema table
- featureflag tenant_type_swap OFF for 2 hours pre
- backup snapshot taken: s3://redwood-backups/20260321/tenants
```
olivia: Rollback hatch plan (condensed): if DDL fails or backfill error rate > 1% for 3 min OR latency > 200ms p95 on API ->
- step 1: abort backfill (job cancel)
- step 2: re-acquire previous schema using pinned migration version: run `schema_manager rollback 20260320.9`
- step 3: flip api back to previous runtime tag and enable featureflag
- step 4: notify ops-channel + incident page
matt-ops: How do we surface the lock/lease state? want a simple command to force-release in case deploybot flaps.
kevin-db: we'll use `deployctl lease status tenant-<id>` and `deployctl lease release tenant-<id> --force`. Test locally did force-release as last resort.
ryan-sre: also add a short runbook snippet in the thread for on-call: step-by-step rollback commands + keys. Keep it minimal.
anika: I'll be watching smoke tests and sampling rows. If any mismatch with canonical set I will call abort.
deploybot: migration-job/20260321-tenant-swap started at 23:05:12 UTC on pool-dedicated-gpu-1. Logs: https://logs.redwood.internal/20260321/migration-job-3421007777
kevin-db: Starting preflight now. If anything unexpected we echo `PRELIGHT-FAIL` and abort.
olivia: thanks all. I'll post a short release note after post-checks. Please standby 23:00-23:40 UTC. :thumbsup:
